title_english: Advice and Moral Guidance to Children
description: Traditional counsel on diligence, virtue, respect for elders, and righteous living imparted by elder Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik.
full_translation: You asked me to tell a story, but what story will I tell? A children's story. What type of children's story? He asked for a children's story.	Children, during childhood, they don't know how to speak. The adults, the parents will tell them what they should know. 'Do not do what is not good.'These children, we teach these children that they should do good, do like this! This is good, that is not good. The stories for teaching children are all that you tell them, from us to the grandchildren.We may say, 'You all be good, when I go to Margherita, don't quarrel. Don't you fight each other. Don't fight and hit each other. Live peacefully, until I come home!''If you are hungry, you have parents, ask them for food. Don't live in hunger at home. When it is time to go to school, eat and then go to school. Go and study at school. Eat your food after coming back!'	This is the story of teaching grandchildren, the extent of the words that children take to keep. 	Then, there is the story of us adults.
